summary: Replaced all ten google-search WIP placeholder specs with an internally consistent, evidence-grounded specification set for a single-node self-hostable search engine, including 13 automated acceptance criteria each mapped to a named test file and four reproducible manual checks.
checksNotRun: Implementation tests AC-01..AC-13 do not exist yet; the criteria name the tests that a future build must add.
MANUAL-01..MANUAL-04 require a running implementation and were not executed.
decisions: Scoped the MVP to a bounded single-node corpus rather than general-web parity, matching the opportunity spec and the dossier's stated gap.
Reused OpenSearch for BM25 instead of hand-writing an index, per the opportunity spec's reuse-before-build rule.
Kept the v1 contract as a documented JSON API and deferred OpenSearch DSL compatibility.
Cited only sources already present in the dossier and opportunity spec; no new claims about Google were introduced.
risks: The specification describes software that does not exist yet; no acceptance criterion is currently proven.
The latency target (p95 < 200 ms) is untested and depends on corpus size and hardware, which the criteria require to be recorded.
recommendedNextAction: Open the T4.1 implementation task and build the document model, health endpoint, and single-seed crawl first, adding AC-01/AC-07/AC-11 tests before widening scope.
